newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK's Pico equity issue to raise HK$170 mln.
newsitem.headline: HK's Pico equity issue to raise HK$170 mln.

text.p: Pico Far East Holdings Ltd said on Wednesday it will issue 55.50 million new shares to its controlling shareholder at HK$3.125 per share to raise a total of HK$170 million after expenses.
The exhibition stands designer and maker said Nastar Holdings S.A., which holds 47.70 percent in Pico, agreed to subscribe to the shares through unit Pine Asset management Ltd.

Pine Assest also agreed to privately place 55.50 million existing Pico shares it held at the same price with independent investors, it said in a statement. The placement and subscription price represented a discount of about 13.8 percent to the shares' Tuesday close of HK$3.625 per share, Pico said.
Pico shares rose to a high of HK$4.30, up HK$0.675 at midday following the news.
Nastar Holdings and parties acting together will hold about 42.2 percent of the firm's enlarged share capital after the deals, it said.

About HK$95 million of the HK$170 million raised from the issue would be used to expand factories in Hong Kong and Singapore, including investments in new equipment. The company also planned to use HK$60 million to repay long term bank loans and the remainder to establish new offices in China.
